text:
maya: brief RFC follow-up: proposing a "rate-hint" microservice at the frontdoor that emits a cheap cost hint before full parse. purpose: let admission/scheduler make faster fairness choices for long requests. reactions?
arpan: sounds useful. what inputs will it use? we should avoid tokenization cost.
maya: keep it tiny: content-length, model tag, first/last N bytes hashed, content-type, and a couple metadata features (client tier, endpoint). optionally a tiny classifier to map into buckets: interactive|long|embed|bulk.
jun: sensitive data concern: hashed prefixes ok, but we must never forward plaintext payloads to sidecars. frontdoor owns hashing and only sends nondeterministic digests.
maya: exactly. no plaintext leaves the frontdoor. we also sign the hint blob so downstream can't be spoofed.
sam: enforcement semantics? Is the hint authoritative or advisory?
maya: advisory for admission shaping. final billing and throttles still use accurate token counts returned by runtime. hints only affect pre-scheduling.
leah: attackers could craft short prefixes to game the hint. can we cross-check with abuse signals?
maya: yes. admission = base_policy + hint_weight + abuse_score. If runtime reveals major mismatch we escalate the tenant's abuse score and tighten shaping.
arpan: deployment model: sidecar RPC vs in-process. sidecar allows iterative dev and language-agnostic frontdoors; inproc is lower latency. start sidecar.
jun: telemetry plan: emit correlation_id, hint_bucket, hint_estimate_range, actual_tokens_on_completion, model, tenant_id. drive a daily confusion matrix and alert if false-neg > threshold.
sam: streaming edgecases? streaming first chunk may be tiny and misleading.
maya: for streaming, produce an initial hint then allow periodic recompute at chunk boundaries. admission uses latest hint; escalation if cumulative tokens outgrow estimate.
leah: rollout: dark-run (no action) -> sampled opt-in tenants -> 10% traffic -> ramp with rollback gating and canary sweeps on top tenants. automated rollback if misclassification spikes.
arpan: header design: X-RW-Rate-Hint: long; X-RW-Rate-Estimate: 512-2048; X-RW-Rate-Sig: v1:... ; ensure signatures verified at admission.
maya: good. config knobs: hint_weight (0..1), verify_signature, conservative_fallback_on_mismatch.
jun: metrics dashboard: per-tenant misclass rate, cost delta when admitting by hint vs by actual, latency delta, and top offending tenant list.
sam: product tradeoff: soft-weighting per-bucket vs hard isolation. recommend soft-weighted first to avoid utilization cliffs.
leah: also add adversarial tests to our fuzzing suite that craft prefix-only payloads to attempt misclassification.
deploy-bot: schedule: canary rate-hint v0.1 to staging tonight 22:00 UTC :rocket:
maya: I'll post the proto in repo and share a small demo video for infra sync. will also create the rollout checklist and telemetry dashboards. thanks all.
